name: Temur
description: The Temur are one of the five clans of Tarkir, a semi-nomadic green-blue-red clan of the Qal Sisma mountains who live in accord with nature and admire the dragons' savagery.

"Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

summary.text: The Temur are one of the five clans of Tarkir, a semi-nomadic green-blue-red clan of the Qal Sisma mountains who live in accord with nature and admire the dragons' savagery.

bio.text: The clan's khan is not hereditary, and in the original timeline Surrak became khan and led its warriors, who fought the Sultai and the Mardu.

bio.text: A Temur band mistook Sorin for a Sultai demon-spawn, and the Temur told him the Spirit Dragon gave them magic to fight corrupted dragons.

citations.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

bio.text: They attacked the Mardu because Sarkhan turned into a dragon in Temur forests and was mistaken for the new Mardu khan, and Temur ambushes killed over a hundred Mardu.

citations.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

bio.text: In the altered timeline Yasova Dragonclaw led the clan, ceding some lands to the Sultai and feeding Atarka mammoth carcasses to save the Temur from attack.

bio.text: Under the dragonlords, Atarka purged the whisperers, stripped the Temur of their identity and reorganized survivors into a clan dedicated to feeding her.

citations.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Rebels and whisperers combined to defeat Atarka and the other dragonlords, after which the Temur resumed their spiritual traditions and nomadic life.

Eshki Dragonclaw (Tarkir: Dragonstorm Promos, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Surrak leads a growing band of clan fighters, soon second only to the Dragonclaw and Hunt Caller in blades.
timeline.quote: From that day, he led clan fighters to hunt both game and foes.

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Weary from pursuing Sultai raiders, Surrak's party catches a group of scavengers and shambling dead under three serpent-folk, including their own lost clansfolk.
timeline.quote: The Temur spat curses as they recognized the emaciated forms of their own clansfolk, lost to hunger and disease.

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Outnumbered Temur are overrun until the cave bear bursts in and rips through the Sultai ranks to Surrak's side, turning the battle.
timeline.quote: The cave bear crashed into the ranks of the Sultai, ripping apart the gaunt zombies

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: A Temur band mistakes Sorin for a Sultai demon-spawn and Sorin kills two warriors with death magic and raises them as vampire thralls.
timeline.quote: Sorin reached out his hand and willed the two leathery corpses back from the dead.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: The Temur guide tells Sorin that dragons have been hunted to extinction and that the Spirit Dragon gave the Temur magic to fight corrupted dragons.
timeline.quote: But some say that the dragons became greedy and corrupt, so the Spirit Dragon gave us magic to fight them.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Atarka purges the whisperers, stripping the Temur of their identity and reorganizing survivors into a clan dedicated to feeding her.
timeline.quote: Atarka initiated a purge of the whisperers, fearing their elemental magic

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A blizzard and Temur ambush kill a hundred Mardu in the mountains.
timeline.quote: Temur struck from the snow, killing a hundred Mardu and losing only twenty of their numbers.

citation.text: "Varuk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zurgo surveys the Mardu army after defeating a Temur force and rallies it with a victory speech.
timeline.quote: Surrak has tested our borders," he shouted, "and we have shown him that they are strong.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: A messenger reveals the Temur attacked because a man calling himself Sarkhan turned into a dragon in Temur forests and the Temur mistook him for the new Mardu khan.
timeline.quote: He…they say he turned into a dragon. And breathed fire on them, took off, and flew farther into Temur territory.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Temur raiders strike the center of the Mardu line twice and vanish into the woods, killing over a hundred Mardu.
timeline.quote: Fifty Temur arranged in a column broke into our line, killed fifty-six, and disappeared back into the woods.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Yasova Dragonclaw cedes a portion of Temur lands to the Sultai, including the krushok breeding grounds.
timeline.quote: In a stunning act of diplomacy, Yasova Dragonclaw ceded a portion of Temur lands to the Sultai.

citation.text: Feral Krushok (Fate Reforged, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Yasova feeds Atarka mammoth carcasses, saving the Temur from attack.
timeline.quote: Yasova satiated her hunger by feeding her mammoth carcasses

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Broods of the Dragonlords". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebels and whisperers combine forces to defeat Atarka and the other dragonlords.
timeline.quote: their combined might led to Atarka's defeat alongside the other dragonlords.

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Revival of the Temur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Atarka's fall the Temur resume their spiritual traditions and nomadic life.
timeline.quote: After the fall of Atarka, the spiritual traditions of the Temur began to be practiced once again, as well as their nomadic way of life.

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Revival of the Temur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ureni sees blue threads binding the sleeping Temur and standing vigil over a camp of the dead.
timeline.quote: Azure wraps around the people of the Temur as they sleep, leaping from one family to the next, binding wrists and throats and tongues.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Eshki and Alniul travel toward Rainveil Forest, tending to the dead and quelling those who would abandon the sick.
timeline.quote: We do not leave our clan behind,

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: The Sultai approach silently and the Temur respond deafeningly.
timeline.quote: The Sultai approach was silent. The Temur response was deafening.

citation.text: Glacierwood Siege (Tarkir: Dragonstorm Promos, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Temur topple an effigy of Atarka's tyranny.
timeline.quote: With an echoing crash the effigy fell, the symbol of Atarka's tyranny expunged from Temur lands.

citation.text: Heritage Reclamation (Tarkir: Dragonstorm, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eshki is chosen as Dragonclaw by the whisperers and proves herself in battle.
timeline.quote: Some had doubted the whisperers' choice of Eshki for Dragonclaw.

citation.text: Dragonclaw Strike (Tarkir: Dragonstorm, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Through Narset's research, the clans learn to summon and bind spirit dragons and overthrow the dragonlords who had ruled the plane.
timeline.quote: the clans were able to overthrow the dragonlords who had ruled the plane

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zurgo's warband, including Batar, beats back attacking Temur warriors and learns the attack was prompted by Sarkhan Vol invading Temur territory.
timeline.quote: beating back attacking Temur warriors

citation.text: "Batar Throatslasher", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Temur ambush the Mardu from the snow, killing a hundred Mardu; Zurgo hands out battle names to newly blooded warriors and Batar angrily challenges him.
timeline.quote: Temur struck from the snow, killing a hundred Mardu and losing only twenty of their numbers.

citation.text: "Batar Throatslasher", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three commune with the land's spirits and pledge that all are welcome at the Temur fires, ending the blight; Surrak rejoins the clan.
timeline.quote: They pledged that all would be welcome at the fires of the Temur, and the blight was brought to an end.

citation.text: "Surrak", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
